brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Tallyline, the invoicing and cash-flow forecasting product in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm and trustworthy, friendly to freelancers, not the generic fintech blue-and-green. Web app only.

claim.notes: Horizon (plum T with a rising bar toward an ochre dot) passed the critic gate at 6.77 and was finalized with insufficient-evidence originality accepted; split-stick failed on distinctiveness and tl-ligature was dropped at sketch review.

concepts.title: Horizon
readsAs: a T with a bent arm and a ball (person kicking / sun over a ridge)
a letter T with a dot
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 S-curve/sun glyph; s2 a T with a bent bar and a dot; s3 minus plus pill (equals sign); s4 dash and dots (loading/ellipsis); s5 swoosh and dot (moon/Nike-like). Keep s2: only one with letter T plus forecast lift, 88% at 16px. Fix: the dot is timid at 32px, make the lift one confident gesture, avoid reading as a tap or pipe, own the plum/ochre pair.

concepts.title: Split Stick
readsAs: a rounded block with an interlocking notch (Tetris-like piece)
two nested L shapes / a toggle or battery UI icon
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 zipper/cracked bar; s2 hash or grid of slashes; s3 a T split on a zigzag; s4 two saw blades/combs; s5 a key. Pick s3 reluctantly: the only one pairing the letter T with the real tally-stock-and-foil story. Risks: reads as a broken or cracked T (bad for money), 47% stock-shape similarity, zigzag detail mushy at 16px. Fix: fewer, bolder teeth (2-3), make the seam clearly a fit not a crack.

concepts.title: TL Ligature
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 exclamation mark or broken 'i'/'l' (different letter, alert icon); s2 loading spinner/progress ring; s3 plain tally-mark icon (the product's own object, cliche); s4 a U or checkmark with a hook. None clears distinctiveness/memorability 7: s1 is a warning glyph, s2 a spinner, s3 a cliche, s4 a U/tick. Direction dropped.
